name: Video Text Detection and Recognition Dataset
description: A dataset and benchmark for detecting and recognizing (localizing and transcribing) text appearing in video frames under motion, compression, and scene variation.
evaluation_method: F1 (detection) and word accuracy / exact match (recognition)
reputation: A commonly cited early benchmark for video OCR / text-in-video tasks; moderately used in the OCR research community but superseded by larger modern datasets.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark focused on video frames; metrics split between detection and recognition; dataset is relatively limited in size and domain compared to more recent large-scale video-text datasets; potential domain-shift versus contemporary models.
